chunks: But when they forgot to remember the warning, We saved those who prohibited evil, but inflicted on the wicked a dreadful punishment -- requital for their disobedience.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the Banu Isra'il when they forgot the warning?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf illustrates the principle of 'Nafi al-Munkar bi al-Nafs' (removing evil by one's own self) and 'Nafi al-Munkar bi al-Ghayr' (removing evil by others), highlighting how the righteous among Bani Isra'il were spared while the transgressors faced divine retribution. It underscores the communal responsibility to enjoin good and forbid evil, a core tenet of Shia jurisprudence and theology, linking individual piety to collective salvation.
